proposals.before: Wuzhi took a counting stick from an attendant and, holding it, asked the empress dowager, "When Emperor Ren was still alive, why did you enthrone Emperor Sishheng?"
proposals.after: Wuzhi took a counting stick from an attendant and, holding it, asked the empress dowager, "When Emperor Ren was still alive, why did you enthrone Emperor Sisheng?"
proposals.reason: 嗣聖 should be romanized Sisheng, not the doubled-h typo Sishheng.

proposals.before: Before long Liuge invited the emperor to watch a game of pitch-pot, raised a cup in toast, and advanced with a blade hidden in his sleeve.
proposals.after: Before long Liuge invited the emperor to watch a game of chupu, raised a cup in toast, and advanced with a blade hidden in his sleeve.
proposals.reason: 樗蒲 is the gambling game chupu, not pitch-pot (投壺); the literal correctly has chestnut-burr gambling.

proposals.before: Wuzhi said, "Your Highness is a son of Emperor Sishheng; if the rebels seize you, they will not spare you.
proposals.after: Wuzhi said, "Your Highness is a son of Emperor Sisheng; if the rebels seize you, they will not spare you.
proposals.reason: Same Sishheng typo for 嗣聖; should be Sisheng.

decisions.reason: Chinese 〈（何魯不）〉 is a parenthetical annotation for 何魯不; idiomatic's Helubu)〉 leaks closing markup, but bare Helubu drops the English parentheses that mark the gloss—use (Helubu).
Chinese 〈（何魯不）〉 is the parenthetical name 何魯不; literal's duplicated )〉 and 'alternate name, closing parenthesis' text are markup artifacts, and (Helubu) is the accurate clean rendering.
Chinese 嗣聖 is Sisheng; idiomatic's Sishheng is a doubled-h typo, and the proposed Sisheng is the correct romanization.
Chinese 樗蒲 is the gambling game chupu, not pitch-pot (投壺); replacing pitch-pot with chupu restores the source meaning.
Chinese 嗣聖 is Sisheng; idiomatic's Sishheng is the same doubled-h typo, and Sisheng correctly names the emperor in 大王嗣聖子.
